data.title: French protests push UEFA to switch date of Europa League game in Rennes - Bozeman Daily Chronicle
data.content: # French protests push UEFA to switch date of Europa League game in Rennes. ## The prospect of a general strike in France next week amid national protests on cost of living issues has pushed UEFA to change a Europa League match date in Rennes. NYON, Switzerland (AP) — The prospect of a general strike in France next week amid national protests on cost of living issues has pushed UEFA to change a Europa League match date in Rennes. UEFA says Rennes will now host Olympiakos of Greece on Wednesday of next week at 4:30 p.m local time. A protester throws a teargas canister to police after a demonstration against rising living costs in Rennes, France, Saturday, Oct. 24, 2026. Police use a water cannon after a demonstration against rising living costs in Rennes, France, Saturday, Oct. 24, 2026. UEFA said Rennes will now host Olympiakos of Greece on Wednesday of next week at 4:30 p.m. local time (1530 GMT) instead of the Europa League’s scheduled program Thursday.

data.title: Medical Update | Celik and Nico Gonzalez - Yahoo Sports
data.content: # Medical Update | Celik and Nico Gonzalez. Following the Europa League match against Rennes, Zeki Celik, who was substituted at half-time, and Nico Gonzalez experienced muscle discomfort and underwent diagnostic tests this morning. The examinations carried out at J|medical revealed a low-grade injury to Celik's left biceps femoris muscle and a low-grade injury to Nico Gonzalez's right soleus muscle. Both players have already begun their respective rehabilitation programmes.
